messages.subject: Indexing columns of a matrix?
parts:
Hi,

I have code that takes a reactive matrix as input.  When I try to select a column from the matrix using single brackets, I get an error about dimensions, even though I know it's a matrix and that the column in question exists.  Does Shiny have special syntax for this?

Thanks.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Indexing columns of a matrix?
parts:
I do not see such a problem. Please show a minimal reproducible example.

> foo = reactive(matrix(1:12, 4))

> isolate((foo()[, 1]))
[1] 1 2 3 4
> isolate((foo()[, 2]))
[1] 5 6 7 8
> isolate((foo()[, 3]))
[1] 9 10 11 12


Regards,
Yihui
